description: Rewrites sentence-initial pronoun + very + like/likes to really like/likes for Vietlish 'rất thích' transfer.
fp_risk_note: Medium risk. 'very' is correct before adjectives and 'like very much' is a valid English alternative. V1 only rewrites a closed sentence-initial pronoun + very + like/likes pattern and leaves adjective uses (BrE 'very like his father' — 'is' between subject and 'very' breaks adjacency), 'very likely' (\blike\b excludes likely), and 'like very much' untouched.

positive.notes: Very-before-like transfer should become really like.
Third-person singular preserves likes while moving the intensifier.
Plural subject baseline for the rule.

negative.notes: Very before adjective is correct English.
Natural very-much construction must not be rewritten.

negative.input: He is very like his father.
negative.expectedCorrection: He is very like his father.
negative.notes: BrE 'very like' meaning 'similar to' — 'is' between subject and 'very' breaks pronoun-adjacency so the rule abstains.

negative.input: My friend very likes this movie.
negative.expectedCorrection: My friend very likes this movie.
negative.notes: Non-pronoun subject 'My friend': pattern anchors at sentence start with a closed pronoun list (I/you/we/they/he/she/it); a noun phrase subject must not fire.
Auxiliary 'do' between pronoun and 'very': pattern requires pronoun immediately followed by 'very'; 'do' breaks the required adjacency.

negative.input: They very likely made a mistake.
negative.expectedCorrection: They very likely made a mistake.
negative.notes: Adverb 'likely' not verb 'like': pattern uses \blike\b which requires a word boundary after 'like'; 'likely' has 'l' next, breaking the boundary.

negative.input: He very much likes this song.
negative.expectedCorrection: He very much likes this song.
negative.notes: 'much' between 'very' and 'likes': pattern requires 'very' immediately before 'like/likes'; the intervening 'much' breaks adjacency.

negative.input: I'd very like to see her again.
negative.expectedCorrection: I'd very like to see her again.
negative.notes: Contracted 'I'd': pattern anchors with '^(I|you|...)\s+'; the apostrophe in 'I'd' is not whitespace so the sentence-initial pronoun-space adjacency fails.

negative.input: I think I very like this.
negative.expectedCorrection: I think I very like this.
negative.notes: Non-sentence-initial 'very like': pattern is anchored with '^'; the embedded clause 'I very like' is not at position 0 so the rule must not fire.
